shared_elements: long curved or serpentine linear forms
rows of repeated short strokes or parallel marks
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include schematic profile animals and repeated short linear strokes arranged along longer horizontal/curved lines. The major difference is that A is organized around large animal figures and register-like bands, while B is dominated by elongated boat-like linear forms with rows of strokes, with no close counterpart to A’s prominent creatures or stacked composition.
